body.x: AVING NEWSwill open the ‘MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT & MIK NIGHT’ booth (BOOTH # 52843)at CES 2019 EUREKA PARK, the world’s greatest technology exhibition, for 4 daysfrom January 8th (Tues) to January 11th (Fri) in LasVegas, USA.

‘MIKINNOVATION HOT SPOT’ will be a place where promising Korean companies will be introducedto the world, and ‘MIK NIGHT’, which will be held on the 3rd nightof the exhibition, will be a networking party where Korean companies will beable to invite interact with investors, media, and buyers that they have met atCES. Let’s look at 5 reasons why ‘MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT & MIK NIGHT’ isnot just another booth amongst many booths and programs to pass by.
1. An opportunity tomeet leading Korean startups in one location
If you enter 'MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT', you will beamazed by the plethora of revolutionary technology boasted by Korean startups.
2. Business networking party with invited Investors,media, and buyers: ‘MIK NIGHT’
At ‘MIK NIGHT (DAY 3, 16 : 00 ~ 18 : 00)’ you can have adeeper conversation about business with Korean companies participating in CESin a more friendly atmosphere, and form a stronger relationship.
3. Korean snack bar for the media around the world
Korean snacks and drinks are provided to any mediapersonnel working at ‘MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT’ for free. Don’t miss out on anopportunity to enjoy popular Korean snacks.
4. Show magazines with the latest information ofrevolutionary companies

Show magazines with the latest information about promisingKorean companies will be provided at ‘MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT & MIK NIGHT’.This magazine will play a helpful role in conversing with companiesparticipating in ‘MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT’.
5. Korea’s greatest mobile accessory brand products to begiven to the first 100 people to visit ‘MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT’
If you visit ‘MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT’, ‘IRING’ will beprovided to the first 100 visitors. It will be a perfect gift in today’ssociety where the usage of smart phones is high.

On the other hand, MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT, a startup zone, is part of aglobal project zone formed to help Korean startups enter the global market, andis attracting attention for various activities such as exhibitions, pitching,and parties. In addition, “MIK NIGHT PARTY’, an invitational businessnetworking party for investors and media that companies have met during CES, isscheduled to be held on the evening of the 3rd day of theexhibition. Also, the MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT will be co-planned and co-managedby AVING NEWS and GMEG, a domestic and foreign global MICE company.

CES 2019 is a revolutionary forum where companies in the technology fieldthat will lead the 4th Industrial Revolution will be participating,and key categories include 3D Printing, Accessibility, Advertising,Marketing, Content and Entertainment, AR/VR and Gaming, Artificial Intelligenceand Robotics, Audio and Video, Baby Tech, CES Sports Zone, Country Pavilions,Design & Source Showcase, Digital Money, Drones, Enterprise Solutions,Eureka Park, Family and Kids Tech, Fitness, Health and Wellness, High-TechRetailing, Home Cinema, IoT Infrastructure, iProducts, Resilience, Self-DrivingTechnology, Sleep Tech, Smart Cities, Smart Home, Sports Tech, Tourism, VehicleTechnology, Wearables, and Wireless Devices and Services.
